verdict.rationale: Cloudflare is a platform, not itself an agent, so the official-MCP-server axis applies. It operates a documented fleet of first-party remote MCP servers, led by the recommended Code Mode server that covers the whole Cloudflare API (2,500+ endpoints through search()/execute() in about 1k tokens), plus Workers Bindings, Builds, Observability, Docs and others, all served over Streamable HTTP. Agent connection is covered by OAuth and API-token auth, a dedicated agent-setup hub with per-client guides, and a Skills plugin that bundles the servers, and live probes confirm a keyless docs MCP server and a spec-compliant OAuth-gated API MCP server.
